title: What Amphibious Architecture Is
definition: Amphibious Architecture: buildings that float when floods arrive.
description:
Amphibious Architecture — Signature Edition: buildings that float when floods arrive. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature amphibious hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: float foundations rethought, building logistics rebuilt, guide piles reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the utility flex ambition that defines the Signature line.

title: The Signature Vision: Amphibious Architecture
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Amphibious Architecture.
description:
The Signature vision of Amphibious Architecture does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature amphibious hulls program, charter one: master float foundations at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale building logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate guide piles systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Amphibious Architecture becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — The first permanent amphibious hulls hosts 500 residents year-ro
definition: 2030 milestone on the Amphibious Architecture roadmap.
description:
The first permanent amphibious hulls hosts 500 residents year-round, exporting building logistics harvest and utility flex power data.

What must be true first: the float foundations results have to replicate outside the lab, building logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and guide piles operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed float foundations demonstrations, building logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting guide piles uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Amphibious Architecture
definition: Estimates Amphibious Architecture readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Amphibious Architecture components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a amphibious hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Amphibious Architecture Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Amphibious Architecture operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Amphibious Architecture installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 27314 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where float foundations monitoring, building logistics redundancy, or guide piles maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Amphibious Architecture Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Amphibious Architecture: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Amphibious Architecture — buildings that float when floods arrive.

Phase 1 — Prove (float foundations): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (building logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (guide piles): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (utility flex): amphibious hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and floodplains-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
